messages:
Maya: uploaded a small prototype for the trace viewer drilldown + export flow. link: https://intranet.redwood/design/proto/trace-drilldown

Maya: TL;DR — looking for quick feedback on: export affordance placement (sticky header vs kebab), copy for export actions, keyboard + a11y for correlation IDs and stackframe folding. Pinged @jules for a11y eyes.

Alex: I like putting export up in the sticky header so it's always available during long scrolls. worried about screen real estate on narrow widths. Maybe show icon-only at <= 480px, full label otherwise. :thinking_face: 

Sam: backend note — exporting full trace can be heavy. we should support async export with a job id and a toast link, not block the UI. formats: JSON (full), CSV (flattened), HAR for requests. also need rate limits on export jobs.

Jules: a11y notes:
- Use a real <button> for export with aria-label="Export trace JSON" (don't rely on title hover).
- Correlation ID should be in a code-like element with a keyboard-accessible "Copy" button (aria-live polite after copy).
- Collapsible stackframes need aria-expanded and be reachable by keyboard. role=list/role=listitem for the frames.

Jules: example aria snippet:
```
button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Export trace JSON');
copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(id);
  copyBtn.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
});
```

Liz: copy nits: "Copy ID" -> "Copy correlation ID" (more explicit); "Download trace" -> "Export trace (JSON)"; keep verb-first labels. Also timestamp chips need higher contrast on light theme — current gray fails 4.5:1.

Sam: +1 on async export. UX detail: show estimated size and an ETA after user clicks export. also, add debounce on export clicks to avoid duplicate jobs.

Alex: UX suggestion — kebab menu for per-entry exports (like exporting a single request) and a global export in the header for whole-trace. Keep primary action visible.

Maya: question — should permalink update when the drilldown opens? i.e., /traces/ID?span=123 so we can share direct deep links. Also if we async export, should the job appear in a "Tasks" panel?

Jules: permalink yes. For tasks panel, ensure focus management when a task toast opens — return focus to the export button. Use role=status for the toast so screen readers announce completion.

Alex: small microcopy: toast copy = "Export started — we'll email a link when ready" might be too heavy. maybe "Export started — link available in recent downloads" and include a direct "Open" in the toast.

Maya: OK next steps: @sam to sketch the async export API + rate limits, @jules to write the a11y checklist, @liz to update copy mocks, @alex to wire product acceptance criteria. I'll schedule a 15-min design/dev sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
